declaration.name: MANDATE Assay Office
declaration.description: Tests ERC-8004 agents against BNB Smart Chain and publishes the evidence. Six checks, identity, custody, activity, capability, reputation, performance, producing a millesimal fineness. Below 375 no hallmark is struck. Every finding carries the command that re-derives it.

skills.name: Assay an agent
skills.description: Runs six tests against BNB Smart Chain for any ERC-8004 token id and returns a millesimal fineness with every finding and its evidence.

skills.name: Read the trust ladder
skills.description: Returns every rung of the registry funnel with the test that settles it and its population. A rung that cannot be measured returns null rather than a guess.

skills.name: Browse the register
skills.description: Returns agents filtered by rung and category, with coverage attached so a small answer can be told apart from a small registry.

skills.name: Serve the office over MCP
skills.description: The same reads as tools an MCP client can call: assay_agent, read_ladder, search_register, check_duplication and list_offices. Three further tools, open_mandate, hire_over_x402, revoke_session, prepare those actions and return the transaction, payment challenge or command rather than performing them, because this server holds no keys.
examples: claude mcp add --transport http mandate https://mandate-coral.vercel.app/api/mcp
